legal_units.title: Set off and carry forward of losses computed in respect of specified business.
legal_units.text: Any loss, computed in respect of a specified business, referred to in section 46, shall be set off only against profits and gains of another specified business.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 114 Set off and carry forward of losses computed in respect of specified business. Section 114(1): Any loss, computed in respect of a specified business, referred to in section 46, shall be set off only against profits and gains of another specified business.

legal_units.title: Set off and carry forward of losses computed in respect of specified business.
